3584.title: Desktop packaging drops npm runtime dependencies
3584.rootCauseOneLine: Desktop dependency collection omits npm bundled dependencies and file copying excludes its nested node_modules, leaving proc-log missing.
3584.proposedFix: Preserve npm bundled dependency tree and smoke-test npm in final desktop artifacts.
3584.caveats: Shared packaging components reproduced twice on macOS; Linux AppImage and UI not executed. Packaging changes are excluded from automatic simple fixes.
